title: PSA: Tell Claude to use your computer for rendering screenshots, etc.
author: 710cartman
selftext:
Sometimes Claude, for visual changes, trying to reproduce bugs, etc. will render screenshots (or even video occasionally) and they do it on their shitty cloud CPUs with no GPU. If you've ever experienced this, you know what I'm talking about.

I'm impatient as fuck, and it took me longer than I want to admit to have the idea: Hey, Claude, can't you just use my computer to render that shit? And what do you know. They can.

  
Might depend on your setup how it would work, but mine just makes a script I run and viola, they have their screenshots/videos in a small fraction of the time. You usually can't use your computer while it's running, but it's worth it in my case.

  
Maybe this will help others. It speeds up a lot of tasks tremendously.

comments.author: Rude_Arugula_1872
comments.body:
The shitty/cloud cpus and no gpu are running in a safer/sandboxed environment.

In your setup, you're the environment.

Some people (rightfully so), prefer having a basic security layer instead of "just use my pc, I'm impatient as fuck, use whatcha need to do your shit" mentality.

replies.author: Economy_Bedroom3902
replies.body: dockerize it locally then.  It's very misguided to do game dev on cloud compute.  You're almost certainly paying way more than you intend to.

replies.author: 710cartman
replies.body: To each their own. Are you also reading over every piece of code Claude writes before running it on your PC too?

replies.author: caesium23
replies.body: That's what dev containers are for.

replies.author: Rude_Arugula_1872
replies.body: Based on OP's comment and way of operating, do you feel it's logical to assume he has one set up?

replies.author: 710cartman
replies.body: It certainly does its best to.

replies.author: Economy_Bedroom3902
replies.body:
I don't understand how you even got your setup running in cloud compute unintentionally... It's not like that's the default claude code behavior.

The cloud instance is not "Claude" it's a cloud instance you have permitted the company claude to build for you with your codebase checked out into that remote environment. It's simply a computer (almost certainly on amazon web services) running your code, and running claude code.

Yeah, that things going to suck ass for game dev because those systems generally don't even have GPUs.  It's kind of surprising the game ran at all.  But this is what happens when you point a gun at your own foot.

comments.author: Seboklarus133
comments.body: yeah same here, claude code runs on my laptop so it just launches godot itself and takes the screenshots there. i have a script that plays my whole game start to finish and screenshots every window after each change, i just look at the pictures. way faster than anything in the cloud

comments.author: UnimagineDragons
comments.body: Wait until you discover local models and have multiple PCs and get Claude to run those separately. I have Claude on my PC pass my other PC with the good 3060card all the local model generation tasks and it uses hunyuan and then passes back the model through Google drive and my main PC picks it up and adds to the software and then sends a list back to the other computer (with Claude on it) and its like I have an employee at each chair in my office on each computer. And then I have several employees buried in specific folders on said PCs.

comments.author: sirpalee
comments.body: You can use your computer while doing this. Most game engines should be able to render offscreen, run in the background and accept controls via a cli. So the agent doesn't have to actually use computer use, but a specialized tool that's more token efficient.

comments.author: I_pee_in_shower
comments.body: When you use codes or claude code it will use your gpu to render. I have it doen to where Claude can make the whole trailer for me.  Would’t try on Cloud, since You need a lot of tools.
